verdict.rationale: Galileo's metrics overview says the built-in metrics can be extended with custom code-based metrics, and experiments run against metrics of the user's choice. The pricing page also advertises unlimited custom evals. Support is clearly claimed, but the evidence is a single overview sentence with no implementation detail. Missing for 10: docs or SDK examples showing how to write and register a code-based scorer, details on the scorer interface and its inputs/outputs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
